name: octopus-desktop-build-bridge
description: Retired desktop shell; keeps only the Windows PyInstaller helper and delegates to frontend/electron

scripts.electron:build: node -e "console.error('Desktop release builds are Windows-only; use electron:build:win');process.exit(1)"
scripts.electron:build:win: pnpm backend:build:win && pnpm --dir ../../frontend build && pnpm --dir ../../frontend electron:build:win
scripts.electron:build:mac: node -e "console.error('macOS desktop release is disabled until a bundled backend exists');process.exit(1)"
scripts.electron:build:linux: node -e "console.error('Linux desktop release is disabled until a bundled backend exists');process.exit(1)"
